note: Official public evidence. Public listing does not prove account access or successful inference. Conditions, currencies, service tiers and non-token charges must be respected. Unknown is not free. No new quality scores are inferred.

providers.notes: groq.com/pricing redirects to homepage. Official docs list current token prices. qwen/qwen3-32b and Scout shut down 2026-07-17 for free/developer; compound-mini deprecated 2026-09-21. See https://console.groq.com/docs/deprecations. Llama70B now enterprise contact sales; do not retain old public rate.

Shared Inference supports gpt-oss-120b and qwen-3.8-27b. Developer PAYG is for development/evaluation/experimentation; enterprise production capacity quoted separately. One-time $5 activation credit expires after30days. Old inference-docs support/pricing page contradicts current commercial pricing; use www.cerebras.ai/pricing.
Preview models are evaluation-only and may be removed. MiniMax-M3 deployment text-only despite upstream multimodality. Maverick absent from current public list.

NVIDIA Developer Program NIM endpoints free for prototyping; production needs NVIDIA AI Enterprise license. No standard paid per-token tariff verified. Never interpret development access as unrestricted zero-cost production. Catalog lists new KimiK3, DeepSeekV4Pro0813, Nemotron3.5Lightning and Nemotron3Ultra.
Paid Standard synchronous text prices; output includes thinking. Audio input, cache storage and grounding extra. Promos retained with explicit end date. Paid prices are distinct from free tier.

Official model catalog provides exact rates and units. Free token up to 100000 combined tokens/day rolling24h with request limits, may reduce without notice; Pro $12/month dynamically managed allowance and model access, not unlimited. usage_based_only models billed from balance. Terms September30 2026 https://github.com/chigwell/llm7.io/blob/main/TERMS.md . Seed llm7/auto not returned in current catalog.

Worldwide public list currency USD, prices excluding VAT. Official catalog documents base URL https://oai.endpoints.kepler.ai.cloud.ovh.net/v1 . Public price table verifies seeded models rates. Context windows not verified here. Playground free testing not equivalent to unlimited production free API.

Backend billing USD0.011/1000 Neurons; published token equivalents. 10000 free Neurons/day resets00:00UTC. Paid plan needed above allowance; some frontier models require paid plan or AI Gateway credits. Source last updated October9 2026. Exact contexts unverified here.

International .com USD and domestic .cn CNY are distinct tariffs. .cn pricing page open failed but official indexed pricing and dated release notes corroborate CNY rates and Beijing time ranges. Seed Qwen3-8B current exact API tariff not conclusively verified.

Pricing app returns no rendered table in text browser; do not copy international Z.ai or SiliconFlow resale prices. GLM5.3Flash/FlashX docs verified API IDs/context/capabilities. Seed glm-4-flash-250414 doc access failed, free price not assumed.

Current deepseek-flash resolves to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. Legacy deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp accepted but old models retired; billed Flash. deepseek-chat not in current table, no price inferred. Context1M/max output384K.

Singapore International USD tariff below. Region/scope/mode/context matter. Frankfurt Global/China have separate prices. qwen-turbo/qwen3-coder-plus not found on current pricing page; no successor price applied. qwen3.7-plus limited20percent promo lacks expiry; excluded pending exact discounted number.

Production API pay-as-you-go; trial keys limited, noncommercial. command-r-plus alias deprecated September 15 2025 points to command-r-plus-04-2024; seeded command-r7b is not the documented exact ID command-r7b-12-2024. Global pricing page omits Command A card; official model-specific card confirms USD2.5 input/USD10 output per1M tokens https://docs.cohere.com/docs/command-a . Embedded official pricing data contains R/R7B token rates. Command A+ free until model/key rate limits; production Model Vault is separate.

Configured ollama.com is hosted cloud, distinct from local models on own hardware. Standard per-million-token rates use usage credits. Free includes starter credits/smaller starter models; purchased credits unlock all. Pro $20/month or$200/year includes$60 monthly usage; Max$100 includes$300; Team$500 includes$1000 shared. Included usage does not roll over. Off-peak DeepSeek pricing outside12:00-18:00UTC weekdays/all weekends. Old seeded qwen3-coder:480b and deepseek-v3.1:671b missing current pricing table.

Routed requests billed by Hugging Face at underlying provider rate without markup; model:provider suffix fixes provider. Unsuffixed default fastest routing can change cost; no single safe model-only price. Free users monthly $0.10 subject to change; PRO $2 compute credits; organization $2/seat. Credits not unlimited usage. Units API metadata documented at https://huggingface.co/docs/inference-providers/hub-api .

Kiro credits meter agent work, not fixed token tariffs. Free50 credits; Pro$20/1000; Pro+$40/2000; Max$100/5000; Power$200/10000 monthly; taxes excluded. Add-on$0.04/credit, expire12months. First paid upgrade social/BuilderID$20 signup credit; no end date published. Models/prices use exact display names because this source does not verify gateway model IDs. No claim that private kiro-gateway accepts new IDs. Model doc updated October13 2026.

Public catalog provides IDs only, no prices/contexts. Credits pay for inference; provider says exact upstream prices/no markup https://cline.bot/blog/cline-provider-now-runs-on-vercel . Do not infer current costs or perpetual free access from :free suffix; current promotional terms/duration not supplied by catalog. ClinePass separate subscription route, do not conflate with Cline API. Seed openrouter/owl-alpha and both poolside laguna :free IDs absent observed catalog; nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b-reasoning:free present, exact price/promo lifetime unknown.

Live no-auth models list retrieved from configured .ai endpoint; all four seeded IDs absent from observed list. No current price schedule or exact quota verified from JS-only docs. Official old announcement says 2000 requests/day, adjustable/no production SLA https://community.modelscope.cn/675262372db35d1195183bdb.html ; this is historical and must not be treated as current unlimited free pricing.
Fully retired July 30, 2026: playground, model catalog, inference API and BYOK no longer available. Distinct from Copilot; seeded endpoints cannot be treated as current.

Official rendered table verified. API base remains https://api.moonshot.ai/v1. USD excludes taxes. K3 default cache TTL 5min; 1h costs $6/M writes versus $3/M default. Deprecated K2/K2.5/moonshot-v1 omitted. K3 requires successful minimum $1 top-up.

Official rendered API model/pricing tables updated Oct 08 2026. Overseas USD and domestic CNY retained separately. Cache write limited-time free with no expiry published. V2.5/pro auto-route to V2.6 since Oct14 18:00 UTC+8; old IDs invalid Oct21 10:00 UTC+8. Ultraspeed uses customized service/contact; no access presumed. Audio pricing not token-comparable.

Standard global synchronous API rates; all prices USD. Priority is 2x; US regional endpoint 1.1x. Tool invocations billed separately. API catalog requires authentication; public model/rate tables used. Fast 4.7 only Cursor/Grok Build, excluded.

Agent API official provider-billed model prices captured, not direct origin-provider rates. Tool invocation fees extra. Orchestrator separately private preview; same hosted rate rows documented. Widget contains legacy Sonar fields not represented as live Sonar API availability. Use current Agent API exact creator/model IDs.

Official public Chat catalog exact API strings and token prices. Standard serverless pricing, USD. No authenticated models API probes. Free input/output only encoded when explicitly published Free. Dedicated-only/image/audio pricing excluded.

Headline Standard synchronous USD rates verified. Included exact pinned IDs explicitly documented in open-models; Fast, Priority and US-only premiums excluded from Standard rows. Other public models use parameter/architecture pricing, and full authenticated catalog not probed. Context unknown where not separately verified.

Authoritative public JSON contains 25 active public models and per-million rates. USD billing supported by official billing docs and public UI dollar prices. UI notes prices approximate and usage-dependent. Cached price omitted means unknown; no inferred discount. Embedding output rate is not applicable, left null.

Old indexed inference pricing/model pages are about 1.3 years stale. Current official /pricing returns HTTP404 and docs redirect to GPU-cloud overview. No current official standard per-token price table verified, so no rows invented. Dedicated GPU/hour offerings cannot be translated to token rates.
